subject: Your 3-day meeting clarity challenge
preview_text: Commit to 3 days. See the difference yourself. No more lost action items.
body_paragraphs: Remember the last meeting where you walked out with a head full of notes and zero clear next steps? That chaos is a choice now. A 3-day challenge can break the cycle.

Here's the deal: open Smart Notes before your next three meetings. After each one, tap 'summary' and let the AI extract key points and action items. By day three, you'll see a pattern—your memory feels sharper, your follow-ups are cleaner, and you've saved at least an hour of rewriting notes.

This isn't about a feature; it's about a habit. The one-tap recording and structured summary are your tools. Hit record, get the transcript, and share it instantly. Users who do this for 3 days don't go back to old habits.
Start your first meeting tomorrow. Open the app, tap record, and let the AI take over. P.S. After day three, you'll wonder why you didn't start sooner. Try it and prove yourself right.
